target.rawSql:
-- one region per failure: FAILURE pulse -> repair completed (point while the work order is open)
SELECT
    failure_ts AS time,
    coalesce(completed_ts, failure_ts) AS timeEnd,
    concat(engine_id, ' failed at cycle ', toString(failure_cycle), ': ', failure_mode,
           if(maintenance_status = 'COMPLETED',
              concat(' (repaired in ', toString(downtime_seconds), ' s)'),
              ' (work order open)')) AS text,
    concat(engine_id, ',', failure_mode) AS tags
FROM raw_maintenance_log FINAL
WHERE is_deleted = 0
  AND $__timeFilter(failure_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 1000

description: Operations board of the jet-engine fleet: status, health score, anomaly flags and the RUL prediction of every engine, live 1 Hz sensors, and the failure/repair timeline.

panels.title: Engines monitored
panels.description: Engines on the fleet board (gold fct_engine_health_status, one row per registered engine).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS engines
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL
WHERE $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: Operational status
panels.description: Current registry status of the selected engines. 'In repair' counts FAILURE and MAINTENANCE_RESET (a work order is open or the engine is being reset to a new lifecycle).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    countIf(operational_status = 'HEALTHY') AS Healthy,
    countIf(operational_status = 'WARNING') AS Warning,
    countIf(operational_status = 'CRITICAL') AS Critical,
    countIf(operational_status IN ('FAILURE', 'MAINTENANCE_RESET')) AS `In repair`
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL
WHERE $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: High-risk engines
panels.description: Engines whose RUL prediction, aged to the current cycle, is in the HIGH band (failure predicted within the horizon, or RUL at or below RUL_FAILURE_HORIZON_CYCLES).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(risk_band_adjusted = 'HIGH') AS high_risk
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL
WHERE $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: Anomaly flags raised
panels.description: Sum of the calibrated anomaly flags over the selected engines: EGT drift, vibration growth, oil-pressure drop and stale telemetry (fct_engine_health_status.anomaly_count).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(anomaly_count) AS flags
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL
WHERE $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: Lowest remaining life
panels.description: The engine closest to failure: smallest predicted RUL aged to its current cycle (predicted_rul_cycles_adjusted). Red at or below the 25-cycle horizon, orange within twice it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT engine_id, predicted_rul_cycles_adjusted AS rul_cycles
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL
WHERE predicted_rul_cycles_adjusted IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY predicted_rul_cycles_adjusted ASC, engine_id
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Telemetry age
panels.description: Seconds between the newest 1 Hz pulse in ClickHouse (raw_engine_telemetry.event_ts) and the end of the time range: the whole simulator -> Postgres -> Debezium -> Kafka -> Spark -> ClickHouse lag. Red past the 300 s stale-telemetry threshold.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT greatest(
           toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__toTime_ms) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(maxOrNull(event_ts)),
           0) / 1000 AS age_s
FROM raw_engine_telemetry
WHERE event_ts > $__toTime_ms - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  AND event_ts <= $__toTime_ms
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: Fleet health board
panels.description: One row per engine from gold fct_engine_health_status (rebuilt by dbt every DBT_INTERVAL_SECONDS): registry status, current cycle, the sensor-driven health score (100 = healthy; bands calibrated on the live fleet: HEALTHY pulses p05 80, WARNING median 58, CRITICAL median 3), the four calibrated anomaly flags, and the newest RUL prediction of the current lifecycle aged to the current cycle (cycles, flight hours, risk band). Sorted by risk, then remaining life. Click an engine for its vibration analytics.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    engine_id AS `Engine`,
    engine_model AS `Model`,
    operational_status AS `Status`,
    current_lifecycle_id AS `Lifecycle`,
    current_cycle AS `Cycle`,
    health_score AS `Health score`,
    is_egt_drift_anomaly AS `EGT drift`,
    is_vibration_growth_anomaly AS `Vibration growth`,
    is_oil_pressure_drop_anomaly AS `Oil pressure drop`,
    is_telemetry_stale AS `Stale telemetry`,
    predicted_rul_cycles_adjusted AS `RUL now (cycles)`,
    predicted_rul_hours_adjusted AS `RUL now (hours)`,
    failure_probability AS `P(failure in horizon)`,
    risk_band_adjusted AS `Risk`,
    model_version AS `Model version`
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL
WHERE $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY
    multiIf(risk_band_adjusted = 'HIGH', 0, risk_band_adjusted = 'MEDIUM', 1,
            risk_band_adjusted = 'LOW', 2, 3),
    predicted_rul_cycles_adjusted,
    health_score,
    engine_id

panels.title: RUL now by engine (cycles)
panels.description: Predicted remaining cycles of each engine, aged from its scored pulse to the current cycle (fct_engine_health_status.predicted_rul_cycles_adjusted). The regressor's target is capped at RUL_CAP_CYCLES (125). Empty for an engine whose new lifecycle has not been scored yet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT engine_id, predicted_rul_cycles_adjusted AS rul_cycles
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL
WHERE $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY engine_id

panels.title: Predicted RUL per engine
panels.description: Every scoring of gold_engine_rul_predictions (latest prediction per time bucket). The saw-tooth is the lifecycle: RUL falls towards the failure, then resets after the repair. The red band is the 25-cycle failure horizon (risk HIGH).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(predicted_at) AS time,
    engine_id,
    argMax(predicted_rul_cycles, predicted_at) AS rul_cycles
FROM gold_engine_rul_predictions
WHERE $__timeFilter(predicted_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Failure probability within the horizon
panels.description: Calibrated probability that the engine fails within RUL_FAILURE_HORIZON_CYCLES (highest scoring per time bucket), with the decision threshold of the model that produced the predictions (tuned for F1 on out-of-fold calibrated probabilities; stored in ml_model_runs.params_json).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(predicted_at) AS time,
    engine_id,
    max(failure_probability) AS p_failure
FROM gold_engine_rul_predictions
WHERE $__timeFilter(predicted_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time

SELECT
    $__timeInterval(p.predicted_at) AS time,
    max(JSONExtract(r.params_json, 'decision_threshold', 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS decision_threshold
FROM gold_engine_rul_predictions AS p
INNER JOIN ml_model_runs AS r ON r.model_version = p.model_version
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.predicted_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Health score by engine
panels.description: Sensor-driven health score of fct_engine_health_status: 100 x (1 - the largest of the scaled EGT drift, vibration growth and oil-pressure drop KPIs). Bands: red < 25, orange < 50, yellow < 80.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT engine_id, health_score
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL
WHERE $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY engine_id

panels.title: Live sensors (1 Hz CDC telemetry, raw_engine_telemetry FINAL)
Exhaust gas temperature
panels.description: Mean egt_c per time bucket of the current pulse versions (FINAL collapses CDC replays and updates, deleted pulses are excluded). EGT rises with hot-section wear (HPT blade erosion, compressor fouling).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(event_ts) AS time,
    engine_id,
    avg(egt_c) AS egt_c_avg
FROM raw_engine_telemetry FINAL
WHERE is_deleted = 0
  AND $__timeFilter(event_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Vibration
panels.description: Mean vibration_mm_s per time bucket of the current pulse versions (FINAL collapses CDC replays and updates, deleted pulses are excluded). Vibration amplitude and its variance grow with bearing wear.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(event_ts) AS time,
    engine_id,
    avg(vibration_mm_s) AS vibration_mm_s_avg
FROM raw_engine_telemetry FINAL
WHERE is_deleted = 0
  AND $__timeFilter(event_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Oil pressure
panels.description: Mean oil_pressure_psi per time bucket of the current pulse versions (FINAL collapses CDC replays and updates, deleted pulses are excluded). Oil pressure drops shortly before failure, steepest for oil-system leaks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(event_ts) AS time,
    engine_id,
    avg(oil_pressure_psi) AS oil_pressure_psi_avg
FROM raw_engine_telemetry FINAL
WHERE is_deleted = 0
  AND $__timeFilter(event_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Operational status timeline
panels.description: Status transitions of every engine from the CDC history of engine_status_registry (raw_engine_status_registry keeps every version): HEALTHY -> WARNING -> CRITICAL -> FAILURE -> MAINTENANCE -> HEALTHY. The state at the start of the range is carried in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    time,
    engine_id,
    transform(status, ['HEALTHY', 'WARNING', 'CRITICAL', 'FAILURE', 'MAINTENANCE_RESET'],
              [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], 5) AS status_code
FROM
(
    -- state at the start of the range: the last transition before it
    SELECT
        engine_id,
        toDateTime64($__fromTime, 6, 'UTC') AS time,
        toString(argMax(operational_status, status_changed_ts)) AS status
    FROM raw_engine_status_registry
    WHERE is_deleted = 0
      AND status_changed_ts <= $__fromTime
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
    GROUP BY engine_id
    UNION ALL
    -- every transition inside the range (status_changed_ts only moves on a change)
    SELECT DISTINCT
        engine_id,
        status_changed_ts AS time,
        toString(operational_status) AS status
    FROM raw_engine_status_registry
    WHERE is_deleted = 0
      AND status_changed_ts > $__fromTime
      AND status_changed_ts <= $__toTime
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Maintenance work orders
panels.description: Current version of every work order opened by a failure in the range (raw_maintenance_log FINAL): failure cycle and mode, repair status and downtime, and how many pulses of the lifecycle were back-flagged with the work order (CDC updates of engine_telemetry).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    failure_ts AS `Failed at`,
    engine_id AS `Engine`,
    lifecycle_id AS `Lifecycle`,
    failure_cycle AS `Failure cycle`,
    failure_mode AS `Failure mode`,
    maintenance_status AS `Work order`,
    completed_ts AS `Repaired at`,
    downtime_seconds AS `Downtime`,
    warning_rows_flagged AS `Pulses back-flagged`,
    action_taken AS `Action`
FROM raw_maintenance_log FINAL
WHERE is_deleted = 0
  AND $__timeFilter(failure_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY failure_ts DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Failures by mode
panels.description: Failures in the range per failure mode (the work order's failure_mode). Each lifecycle draws one mode, which amplifies its dominant sensors.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT failure_mode, count() AS failures
FROM raw_maintenance_log FINAL
WHERE is_deleted = 0
  AND $__timeFilter(failure_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY failure_mode
ORDER BY failures DESC, failure_mode

list.definition:
-- engines that are registered and not deleted (current CDC state of the registry)
SELECT engine_id
FROM raw_engine_status_registry
GROUP BY engine_id
HAVING argMax(is_deleted, cdc_lsn) = 0
ORDER BY engine_id
list.description: Engines currently in the registry (raw_engine_status_registry, latest CDC version per engine).
list.label: Engine
list.name: engine_id

query.rawSql:
-- engines that are registered and not deleted (current CDC state of the registry)
SELECT engine_id
FROM raw_engine_status_registry
GROUP BY engine_id
HAVING argMax(is_deleted, cdc_lsn) = 0
ORDER BY engine_id
